title: Scroll Back
blurb: Phones, games, space and sports since 2000, scrambled up with stuff way older.

cards.say: [Tetris was invented in Moscow, back in the Soviet Union], [the PlayStation started out as a Sony project with Nintendo], [Mario was a carpenter before he became a plumber], and [the first version of Minecraft came out before Roblox launched].
cards.real: Roblox launched in 2006. Minecraft's first public test version didn't come out until 2009.

cards.say: [the first item sold on eBay was a broken laser pointer], [the first YouTube video showed a cat playing the piano], [one of the first webcams was set up just to watch a coffee pot], and [Google's name comes from googol, a 1 followed by 100 zeros].
cards.real: The first YouTube video, posted in 2005, is an 18-second clip of a co-founder at the San Diego Zoo talking about elephants.

cards.say: [in 2018, a rocket launched a sports car into orbit around the Sun], [in 2022, NASA crashed a spacecraft into an asteroid on purpose], [in 2019, the Hubble telescope took the first photo of a black hole], and [in 2021, a helicopter made the first powered flight on another planet].
cards.real: The first black hole photo came from the Event Horizon Telescope, a team of radio telescopes linked up around the world, not from Hubble.

cards.say: [the very first iPhone came with the App Store built in], [the first text message ever sent said Merry Christmas], [Bluetooth is named after a Viking king], and [the word emoji comes from Japanese, not from the word emotion].
cards.real: The first iPhone came out in 2007 with no App Store. The App Store opened a year later, in July 2008.

cards.say: [in 2016, the Chicago Cubs won their first World Series since 1908], [at the Tokyo Olympics in 2021, two 13-year-olds won gold and silver in skateboarding], [in 2008, Michael Phelps won 9 gold medals at one Olympics], and [in 2012, a skydiver fell faster than the speed of sound].
cards.real: Phelps won 8 gold medals at the 2008 Beijing Olympics, beating the record of 7 that Mark Spitz set in 1972.

cards.say: [Shrek won the very first Oscar for Best Animated Feature], [the first Harry Potter book's first hardcover run was just 500 copies], [Gangnam Style was the first YouTube video to reach a billion views], and [Frozen was the first animated movie to earn a billion dollars].
cards.real: Toy Story 3 was the first animated movie to pass a billion dollars, in 2010. Frozen got there in 2014.

cards.say: [in 2015, scientists first detected ripples in space called gravitational waves], [in 2006, Pluto was demoted because astronomers found it had no moons], [in 2013, the Curiosity rover played Happy Birthday to itself on Mars], and [in 2004, a Mars rover built to last 90 days landed and kept working for over 14 years].
cards.real: Pluto has five known moons. It lost planet status because it hasn't cleared other objects out of its orbit, a rule for full planets.

cards.say: [Facebook was first open only to students at Stanford], [Instagram was an iPhone-only app when it launched], [TikTok merged with the lip-sync app Musical.ly in 2018], and [the first dot-com domain name was registered in 1985].
cards.real: Facebook launched in 2004 just for Harvard students. It opened to other colleges next, and later to everyone.

cards.say: [in 2001, the first space tourist flew up on NASA's space shuttle], [the Hubble telescope launched in 1990 with a mirror that was the wrong shape], [John Glenn went back to space at age 77], and [in 2015, astronauts ate lettuce they grew on the space station].
cards.real: The first space tourist, Dennis Tito, rode a Russian Soyuz rocket to the space station in 2001, paying about 20 million dollars.

cards.say: [Nintendo's Wii was code-named Revolution before it came out], [Minecraft's very first test version was called Cave Game], [Pac-Man was called Munch Man when it came out in Japan], and [the first Pokémon games were called Red and Green, not Red and Blue].
cards.real: Pac-Man's original Japanese name was Puck Man. It became Pac-Man when it came to America later in 1980.

cards.say: [the first handheld cellphone call was made to the caller's biggest rival], [in 2001, the first iPod promised 1,000 songs in your pocket], [in 2010, Disney became the first studio with two billion-dollar movies in one year], and [in 1974, the first barcode scanned at a store checkout was on a cereal box].
cards.real: The first barcode scanned at a checkout, in Troy, Ohio, in 1974, was on a 10-pack of Juicy Fruit gum that cost 67 cents.

cards.say: [in 1997, a computer called Deep Blue beat chess champion Garry Kasparov], [in 2019, a NASA lander made the first landing on the far side of the Moon], [in 2014, a space probe landed on a comet for the first time], and [Wordle was made by a software engineer as a gift for his partner].
cards.real: The first soft landing on the Moon's far side was China's Chang'e 4, in January 2019. It even dropped off a little rover to explore.
